transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer care and billing, my name is Daniel. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Daniel, my name is Gabriel Miller. I traded in my old iPhone 12 when upgrading to an iPhone 15 thirty days ago, your warehouse confirmed receipt and valuation of one hundred and fifty pounds, but my new invoice has zero credit applied and billed me full price!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Gabriel. I can certainly inspect your trade-in ledger and mobile billing statement. Before we access your finance records, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 84 Victoria Park Road, Exeter, EX1 3PX, and my security PIN is 5104. My trade-in reference number is TRD-881902.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Gabriel, that confirms your account details. What total amount was billed on your latest monthly statement?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The statement billed seventy-five pounds for the handset and tariff, with absolutely no mention of the one hundred and fifty pounds trade-in credit! Daniel, I am furious! I specifically sent my immaculate iPhone 12 in your tracked packaging, Royal Mail signed for it on October 18th, and your automated email promised credit within two billing cycles! I feel completely cheated because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I query our logistics warehouse intake registry and finance reconciliation portal in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Gabriel. I have located warehouse intake report TRD-881902. The iPhone 12 was received, fully inspected, and graded Grade A with the full one hundred and fifty pounds valuation authorized on October 20th so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how frustrating and alarming it is to see a seventy-five pound invoice without your agreed one hundred and fifty pound trade-in credit, Gabriel, especially after sending in your device on time. Let us make sure this is rectified immediately across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Daniel, I appreciate you looking into that so quickly. Why was it not applied to my statement since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A batch transmission delay occurred between our logistics grading database and our recurring subscription billing engine, leaving the credit voucher in unallocated status to ensure your S-Net service operates reliably without unexpected dropped packets or connection faults.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you pull that credit voucher into my billing account right now because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I am executing the manual ledger binding command to attach voucher TRD-881902 directly to your active mobile account so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does that apply the full one hundred and fifty pounds so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the full one hundred and fifty pounds has been posted to your account as an unallocated credit balance to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How will that credit be used against my upcoming payments since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It will automatically offset your current seventy-five pound invoice to zero pounds, and the remaining seventy-five pounds will offset your entire December invoice to zero pounds as well in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So I will have zero pounds to pay for both November and December?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is correct. You will have two consecutive months of completely free mobile service.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is a huge relief to hear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the direct debit mandate to make sure no automated sweep attempts to draw funds for November.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, please ensure my bank account is not debited seventy-five pounds next week!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously automated direct debit sweeps execute unless a zero balance clearance command is submitted to the payment gateway.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I had a terrible experience with another network taking direct debits in error before, so I get very anxious about unexpected bank debits!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand that anxiety, Gabriel. I have locked the November debit sweep to zero pounds in the Bacs gateway right now, so no funds will leave your bank.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Daniel, that puts my mind completely at ease.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am generating an updated PDF invoice reflecting the one hundred and fifty pound credit voucher and sending it to your email address right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me refresh my email inbox on my phone... Yes! 'S-Net Updated Statement - Balance Due: £0.00'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Splendid! And your December statement will also reflect zero balance automatically.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is outstanding service. You resolved everything in one single call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we conclude our call, that registered mobile phone number was 07700 900418, correct?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have allocated your one hundred and fifty pound trade-in credit, cleared your November bill to zero, confirmed December will be zero, and locked the direct debit sweep.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Everything is completely sorted. Thank you Daniel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can monitor your remaining credit balance at any time on the My S-Net mobile app.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will check the app to see the remaining seventy-five pounds.
